protocol.dataset: Open Food Facts random-modulo-1000 product sample
protocol.correct_match: Same barcode as the query photo, using another view in the gallery
protocol.weight_selection: Choose highest calibration top-1, then top-5; prefer lower OCR weight if tied
protocol.package_text_score: 0.8 x product-name token coverage + 0.2 x brand-token match from Vision OCR

source_manifest.image_resolution: 400 px maximum; 200 px used if 400 px variant is absent
